findings.reason: a control whose input cannot be reopened after the run is a claim with no instrument behind it, so the plan should name a snapshot the landed record can carry or a committed fixture — a builder under `tests/` or a fragment path — rather than a `/tmp` copy that is deleted at cleanup as the re-measure's own copy was.
